verdict.rationale: LibreChat's own Code Interpreter is described as executing code in multiple languages "securely with zero setup," which implies isolated execution. An Access Control feature page and per-role/per-group configuration overrides suggest some ability to limit what users or agents can use. However, no evidence describes the isolation mechanism, tool allow/deny policies, or permission modes for MCP or agent tool calls. Docker, Helm and npm deployment are host-level options and earn no credit. Missing for 10: documented container/VM sandbox details for code and tool execution, explicit per-tool allow/deny policies or approval/permission modes for agent and MCP tools, and any independent or hands-on corroboration of containment.
